articles.title: Chainlink teams up with 47 South Korean, European banks to speed up international money transfers
articles.snippet: The alliance, called Project Pangea, plans to use stablecoins to settle multimillion-dollar currency trades between Europe and South Korea in near real time.

articles.title: Chainlink joins European and Korean bank consortia to develop FX settlement network
articles.snippet: Banks across Europe and South Korea will study whether regulated euro and won stablecoins can enable real-time cross-border foreign exchange settlement.

articles.title: $1.9M in Fake Bets Drove Polymarket Hype: WSJ
articles.snippet: A Wall Street Journal probe found none of the roughly $1.9 million in bets shown across 1,100-plus creator videos were real.
